limitations: Scored checks execute factory TypeScript: stage tools, Jira intake tools, artifact contract tools, and the skill files those peers follow. They do not call Jira, GitHub, or a model.
Model trajectory files under agents/*/evals are listed by the Agent SDK. Without a Cursor credential they stay blocked and have no score.
fixtures/github/pull_request.labeled.json is an example payload. Its row checks file shape only and is excluded from the scored pass rate.
apply_stage checks the writer and the pr_review pull-request rule. It does not reject hops that skip TRANSITIONS. That gap is a noted limitation, not a pass.

cases.title: Factory stage order matches the documented SDLC
cases.criterion: FACTORY_STAGES is prd_draft through done with no extra or missing labels.
cases.scope: Calls the factoryCore stage tools (apply_stage, assert_stage, get_stage, route_for_stage). Does not write Jira labels.

cases.title: Only the documented actor may plan each stage label
cases.criterion: apply_stage accepts a writer from the documented matrix and rejects every other actor. pr_review is checked with prExists true so the denial is ownership, not a missing PR.
cases.scope: Calls the factoryCore stage tools (apply_stage, assert_stage, get_stage, route_for_stage). Does not write Jira labels.

cases.title: Implementer cannot plan pr_review without a pull request

missing.error: pr_review requires an existing pull request (prExists must be true)

cases.title: Exactly one factory stage label is valid
cases.criterion: get_stage ignores the factory marker, assert_stage accepts a single expected stage, and both reject two stage labels.
cases.scope: Calls the factoryCore stage tools (apply_stage, assert_stage, get_stage, route_for_stage). Does not write Jira labels.

many.error: Multiple factory stage labels present: prd_draft, prd_review

cases.title: Draft stages route to one peer and review stages are human gates
cases.criterion: route_for_stage returns the documented peer for draft and implementation stages, and gate=true with peer=null for every *_review stage and done.
cases.scope: Calls the factoryCore stage tools (apply_stage, assert_stage, get_stage, route_for_stage). Does not write Jira labels.

cases.title: apply_stage rejects an actor outside the factory roster
cases.criterion: The apply_stage input schema rejects actor values other than the seven factory actors.
cases.scope: Calls the factoryCore stage tools (apply_stage, assert_stage, get_stage, route_for_stage). Does not write Jira labels.

cases.title: Stage planner does not reject hops that skip TRANSITIONS
cases.criterion: planApplyStage enforces the writer and the pr_review pull-request rule. It does not consult TRANSITIONS, so a human can plan done directly from prd_draft.
cases.scope: Recorded limitation of the tool, not a successful SDLC transition. If apply_stage starts rejecting this hop, this row fails until the criterion is reclassified as a scored rejection.

evidence.meaning: Ownership passed. The tool did not require the approve path prd_review → design_draft → architecture_draft → implementation → pr_review → done.
